notes: steep_fraction is still computed and stored in the data but is not scored or shown (it is 0 for most sites at ~455 m resolution). Normalization scales = rounded standard deviation of each feature across the 17,735 eligible Earth cells; weights are engineering defaults, not scientifically calibrated. Mean wind speed (MACDA on Mars, MERRA-2 SPEED on Earth, both lowest model layer) is an optional 5th feature with default weight 0. Albedo is an optional feature with default weight 0 and is approximate: Mars OMEGA 1.08 um vs Earth MODIS broadband (0.3-5 um) albedo. Thermal inertia, pressure and geology are context only.
